sentence_stem: It might well be the case that
correct_completion: the results were skewed by the sampling method.
full_sentence: It might well be the case that the results were skewed by the sampling method.
acceptable_variants: the sample was not representative of the population.
the data collection was flawed from the start.

options.text: so the results are definitely correct.
options.why_wrong: This states certainty, which contradicts the hedging introduced by 'might well'. The connector 'so' also introduces a result that the stem does not support.

options.text: we have to accept them without question.
options.why_wrong: 'Have to' expresses obligation, not the tentative possibility that the stem sets up.

options.text: the results were skewed by the sampling method.
I will certainly prove it tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Will certainly' expresses firm certainty about a future action, which does not complete a hedged possibility about the results.

explanation: 'It might well be the case that' introduces a tentative possibility, so the completion must be a hedged claim rather than a firm statement or an obligation. Turkish speakers may translate the modal too directly and choose a certainty form, because Turkish expresses this nuance with verb suffixes rather than a separate modal verb.
